kind: External density-feature compatibility test; not reproduction of unspecified author contour estimator
input: Actual production folded UTC-hour pooled count grid and its axis coordinates. Never use medians or archived expected-density CSVs.

smoothing.method: Separable discrete Gaussian with normalized kernels; truncate at ceil(3*sigma/bin_width) bins; periodic UTC time, zero-padded SNR without edge renormalization

branch_match.method: Enumerate all strict vertical local maxima (including tied plateaus no wider than one SNR-bin spacing) over the full SNR axis of every hour; only then compare their positions with independently digitized feature boxes. Require at least one mode in each feature box at every bandwidth combination.
branch_match.digitization_basis: Use +/-4 pixels, the larger of the primary +/-3-pixel and fresh independent-review +/-4-pixel bounds for resolved contours. The tentative sub-bin late-night loop is excluded by the annotation resolution rule.

strongest_density_match.method: Every global maximum of the full smoothed density grid must lie within the external evening contour box plus only declared raster and half-bin allowances, at every bandwidth combination.

density_ordering.expected: Both three-hour morning and evening sums exceed the three-hour midday sum. This is a qualitative ordering, not an externally specified absolute count.
density_ordering.source: Printed page26 describes morning/evening spot-density peaks and fewer midday spots; windows align with published three-hour ticks.

interpretation: Passing establishes positional agreement of selected density branches and the strongest island plus the stated qualitative time-of-day density ordering. It does not establish equality of complete distributions, contour levels, probabilities, medians, quantiles or sample counts.
failure_policy: Do not change paper boxes, smoothing or tolerances to pass. Retain and report the first comparison. Investigate mismatches or bandwidth sensitivity separately; no automatic baseline refresh.
